title: 第2652章 左冷禅第2651章 剑殇
content_zh:
剑殇遁走之后，林尘也没有兴趣继续追赶。他还有自己的事情要做，没工夫在无关紧要的人身上浪费时间。随着时间的推移，林尘所凝聚出的血渊令越来越多，炼天熔炉如同一口无底深渊，大量战兽被他直接从远处摄取过来，化为精纯的养料源源不断地注入体内。林尘吸收血渊令的速度快到了令人难以想象的地步，周围那些修行者看得目瞪口呆，却只能眼睁睁看着一块块血渊令如飞蛾扑火般没入林尘周身的光芒之中。
此刻，剑殇就停留在远处，一边调息一边默默观望。他引以为傲的剑道实力，竟然连与林尘正面争锋的资格都没有。要知道，林尘从头到尾确实没有动用任何神兵利器，仅凭自身的剑道造诣便将他镇压到了这般地步。剑殇心中一阵冰凉——可想而知，若是林尘有神兵利器在手，他恐怕早就被镇杀当场了。剑殇的修为境界明明完全凌驾于林尘之上，却被对方打得如此狼狈不堪，这让他如何能够接受？每念及此，胸中便像堵了一块巨石，沉闷得喘不过气来。
剑殇沉着脸，也开始默默吸收血渊令，似乎并不甘心就此认输。而随着时间的推移，血渊秘境深处开始出现越来越多实力强劲的战兽，每一只战兽都裹挟着凌厉的锋芒呼啸而出，杀气腾腾，显然想击杀这些战兽绝非易事。林尘甚至看到了一条体型无比庞大的巨龙，龙鳞在幽暗的秘境中闪烁着冰冷的金属光泽，巨龙奔腾呼啸之间，携带着无与伦比的恐怖杀伤力，所过之处大地崩裂，空气都在龙威的碾压下发出尖锐的嘶鸣。
林尘看到那条巨龙的瞬间，眼底深处便骤然掠过一缕金光。这条巨龙的存在对他而言，意义非同寻常。林尘完全可以承受并汲取这条巨龙的养料，用来大幅提升自己的实力。念及至此，林尘便准备动身迎上去。
而就在林尘打算动身之际，一股可怕的威势已经抢先席卷而来。那条巨龙在发现了林尘之后，竟然主动冲杀过来，巨大的龙瞳中燃烧着贪婪与愤怒交织的火焰。林尘的存在成功地激怒了这条巨龙，更勾起了它心中强烈的贪念。原因并不复杂——林尘体内的龙血太过强横，那股气息在巨龙感知中就如同黑夜中的一团烈火。对于拥有强横龙血的人，这条巨龙当然怀有极致的渴望，那是源自血脉深处的吞噬本能。
除了林尘之外，其他体内拥有龙血的强者也遭到了巨龙的疯狂围攻，一时间哀嚎声四起。众多修行者纷纷退避，却也不忘将目光投向林尘这边。当他们看到林尘也遭到了巨龙的正面攻击时，脸上不由得露出了戏谑的表情。林尘获取血渊令的速度实在太快，早已引得众人眼红嫉妒。他们心中巴不得林尘能死在巨龙利爪之下，这样一来，林尘身上那些珍贵的血渊令和资源，自然就成了他们争抢的囊中之物。
远处，剑殇和渊天明也躲在暗处窥伺。看到林尘遭到巨龙的凶猛攻击，两人都是一副兴高采烈的模样，眼中闪烁着幸灾乐祸的光芒。显然，他们比谁都更期待林尘被那条巨龙当场镇杀。
刹那之间，巨龙身上散发出了令人窒息的惊人威压，龙威如同实质般的浪潮向四周碾压开来。林尘自然也清晰感知到了那股铺天盖地的龙威，龙威浩瀚，席卷之下连空气都变得黏稠沉重。那巨龙没有任何犹豫，裹挟着毁天灭地般的气势朝林尘攻杀过来，举手投足之间都爆发出令人心惊胆战的恐怖战力。没多久，巨龙便已呼啸而至，巨大的阴影将林尘完全笼罩。
然而那巨龙很快就察觉到，眼前这个人类似乎并不是那么好对付的。它眼中闪烁着极致的贪婪，一心只想吞噬林尘体内那股让它垂涎欲滴的龙血，却严重低估了林尘的真实战力。这条巨龙体内流淌着真魔神龙的血脉，可以说血脉之力绝对属于极为强大的存在，寻常修行者在它面前连站都站不稳。然而巨龙在面对林尘的时候，连续几轮猛攻下来，竟也没能讨到半点便宜，反而被林尘的反击打得龙鳞翻飞，暴怒不已。
巨龙仰天咆哮，吼声震天动地。而就在这震耳欲聋的龙吼声中，一道身影悄然逼近——剑殇竟然又冲了回来。在剑殇的身边，还跟着另一位强者，此人身上散发出令人心惊胆战的威压，气息之强甚至盖过了剑殇。此人不是别人，正是光明教暗中培养的另一位天骄，名为左冷禅。
左冷禅周身气势沉凝如山，散发出的气息波动让周围的空气都隐隐扭曲。他整体的战力甚至比剑殇还要强上一筹。光明教要通过万宗盛会来决定未来的归属，乃至决定整个光明圣城下一任城主的继承人，因此他们所培养的天骄可谓层出不穷。剑殇不过是暗中培养的其中之一罢了，相比之下，左冷禅的战力更胜一筹，是光明教真正寄予厚望的底牌之一。
左冷禅远远看到林尘正在与巨龙激烈搏杀，眼中杀机一闪，丝毫没有犹豫便冲了过来。现在就是击杀林尘最合适的时机，若是错过，再想找到这样的机会恐怕就难如登天了。有那条巨龙在近前牵制，巨龙的战力足够强横，完全可以成为他们的一大臂助。与巨龙联手夹击，胜算至少能多出好几成。
左冷禅和剑殇对视一眼，两人同时施展出恐怖的杀招。光明教教主早已下达了死命令，必须将林尘彻底镇杀，因此左冷禅毫不犹豫地来了，目的简单而直接。但在林尘看来，眼前这条气势汹汹的巨龙其实并不是什么不可战胜的敌人，而是一块巨大无比的血渊令。血渊令显然也有明显的档次之分，普通战兽所化的血渊令与这种级别的巨龙相比，品质根本不可同日而语。林尘要的，当然是品质最好的血渊令，而眼前的这条巨龙，大概率就能满足他的需求。
林尘眼中闪烁着灼热的金芒，可以说对这条巨龙渴望到了极点。正好，巨龙也很想要林尘的性命，一人一龙可谓“一拍即合”。巨龙咆哮着，携带着无比恐怖的威压横空杀来，巨大的龙爪撕裂虚空，带着毁天灭地般的力量当头拍下。与此同时，左冷禅、剑殇还有渊天明这几个光明教的天之骄子也同时杀到，正好卡在林尘与巨龙进行激烈肉身搏杀的当口。他们一出手便是毫无花哨的连招，杀招叠出，威力生猛无比，摆明了要将林尘一举置于死地。
林尘自然也不会惯着他们。不能动用神兵利器，对他而言确实会有一定的影响，但他的剑道实力和体内的龙血威能相比于之前都有了翻天覆地的提升。即便不动用神兵利器，战力的损失也没有外人想象的那么大。更何况，前来血渊秘境的人中绝大部分都是年轻天骄，并没有几个老一辈的强者压阵。就算有那么几个真我境的天骄，也仅仅是停留在真我境初期而已，跟林尘根本无法相提并论。
刹那之间，林尘一人独战诸多强敌，剑光与龙息交错，杀意与怒吼交织，场面混乱到了极点。就在这时，叶清霜的身影破空而至。叶清霜之前去了别处，此刻感知到林尘可能遭遇危险，便立刻杀到，毫不犹豫地挡在林尘身侧。叶清霜当然不会眼睁睁看着林尘出事，她周身气息翻涌，目光冷冽如霜，扫向围攻之人时没有半分惧色。
左冷禅之前其实就见过叶清霜，只是那时候的他根本没把叶清霜放在眼里，还以为她的战力远不如林尘，不过是个不足为虑的角色罢了。此刻一轮正面交锋之后，叶清霜竟然能硬生生扛住他的猛攻，仗着强横的肉身之力与左冷禅打得有来有回，甚至隐隐还能占据上风。这让左冷禅的心情郁闷到了极点。
要知道，左冷禅最为擅长的就是肉身之道，他的肉身强度堪称逆天级别。霸王之体一旦爆发，如同摧枯拉朽一般碾压同阶，向来是他最大的底牌。感知到左冷禅霸王之体的厉害之后，叶清霜却没有丝毫怠慢，抬手便是一拳轰出，拳风凛冽，气势如虹。左冷禅的霸王之体当然厉害，但叶清霜的无双之体同样恐怖，两者碰撞在一起，如同两座山岳正面相撞。一轮对轰下来，拥有霸王之体的左冷禅竟然瞬间就被打飞出去，身形在空中翻了几个跟头才勉强稳住。此刻左冷禅的眼眸之中已尽是惊恐之色。
左冷禅万万没有想到叶清霜竟然可以强到这个地步，他实在是有些无法理解了。叶清霜每一拳攻出，都携带着无可比拟的逆天威势，那拳力如同九天惊雷般连绵不绝，让左冷禅的心态都直接崩了。要知道霸王之体最厉害之处就在于其无与伦比的肉身强度，拥有霸王之体的他向来横扫无敌。而即便如此，在全力开启霸王之体的状态下，他照样没能讨到半点便宜，被叶清霜狠狠压制，打得他已经快要失去思考的能力了。
左冷禅一咬牙，关键时刻再不敢托大，抬手便祭出了诸多威力强大的玉符。这些玉符乃是封存了真我境强者全力一击的保命之物，珍贵无比。左冷禅身上有，剑殇身上当然也有。之前剑殇觉得没有十足把握收拾林尘，便没舍得动用那些真我境强者一击的玉符。无极九重境一击的玉符他们身上倒是很多，但真我境强者一击的玉符就截然不同了——价值高出数倍不止，威力更不是一个层面的存在。

此刻玉符被猛然捏碎，封存在其中的恐怖力量如同决堤的洪水般宣泄而出。连续两张真我境玉符在林尘和叶清霜面前轰然爆开，炽烈的光芒吞噬了周围的一切，恐怖的能量风暴向四周席卷扩散。感知到真我境强者玉符的威力后，叶清霜的脸色也变得格外凝重。那可是真我境强者一击的玉符，威力堪称惊天动地，达到了令人窒息的地步。真我境的力量，又岂是那么好应对的？
血渊秘境的历练规则，不允许携带任何神兵利器进入，他们自然也没有神兵利器。但他们有真我境强者一击的玉符。像光明教暗中培养出来的这些绝世妖孽，身上玉符的数量断然不会少，动辄便是十几二十张的存货。此刻连续的真我境强者玉符攻击之下，即便强如林尘和叶清霜，也都感知到了一股不小的压力，仿佛整片空间都在那恐怖的威能下剧烈震颤。

content_en:
After Jian Shang escaped, Lin Chen had no interest in pursuing him. He still has his own things to do and has no time to waste time on unimportant people. As time went by, Lin Chen condensed more and more Blood Abyss Tokens. The Heaven Refining Furnace was like a bottomless abyss. A large number of war beasts were directly ingested by him from a distance, turned into pure nutrients and poured into his body continuously. Lin Chen absorbed the Blood Abyss Token at an unimaginable speed. The practitioners around him were dumbfounded, but they could only watch as pieces of the Blood Abyss Token disappeared into the light around Lin Chen like moths to a flame.
At this moment, Jian Shang stayed in the distance, watching silently while adjusting his breath. The swordsmanship prowess he was so proud of was not even qualified to compete head-on with Lin Chen. You must know that Lin Chen did not use any magic weapons from the beginning to the end, and he was able to suppress him to this point just by relying on his own swordsmanship. Jian Shang felt a chill in his heart - it is conceivable that if Lin Chen had a magic weapon in hand, he would have been killed on the spot. Jian Shang's cultivation realm was clearly superior to that of Lin Chen, but he was beaten so badly by the opponent. How could he accept this? Every time I think about this, it feels like a huge stone is stuck in my chest, making me so heavy that I can't breathe.
Jian Shang had a sullen face and began to silently absorb the Blood Abyss Order, seemingly unwilling to admit defeat. As time goes by, more and more powerful war beasts begin to appear in the depths of the Blood Abyss Secret Realm. Each war beast roars out with a sharp edge and full of murderous intent. Obviously, it is not easy to kill these war beasts. Lin Chen even saw an extremely large dragon. The dragon's scales shone with cold metallic luster in the dark secret realm. As the dragon roared and roared, it carried unparalleled terrifying lethality. The ground cracked wherever it passed, and the air screamed sharply under the crushing power of the dragon.
The moment Lin Chen saw the giant dragon, a ray of golden light suddenly flashed deep in his eyes. The existence of this giant dragon was of extraordinary significance to him. Lin Chen can completely withstand and absorb the nutrients of this giant dragon to greatly enhance his own strength. Thinking of this, Lin Chen prepared to move forward to meet him.
And just when Lin Chen was about to leave, a terrifying force had already swept over him. After discovering Lin Chen, the giant dragon actually rushed towards him, its huge dragon pupils burning with the flames of greed and anger. Lin Chen's presence successfully angered the giant dragon and aroused the strong greed in its heart. The reason is not complicated - the dragon blood in Lin Chen's body is too powerful, and the aura is like a blazing fire in the dark night to the dragon's perception. For those with powerful dragon blood, this giant dragon certainly has the ultimate desire, which is the devouring instinct originating from the depths of the blood.
In addition to Lin Chen, other strong men with dragon blood in their bodies were also frantically besieged by the giant dragon, and for a while, howls could be heard everywhere. Many practitioners retreated, but they did not forget to turn their attention to Lin Chen. When they saw that Lin Chen was also attacked from the front by the giant dragon, they couldn't help but show a joking expression on their faces. Lin Chen's speed in obtaining the Blood Abyss Order was so fast that it had already made everyone jealous. In their hearts, they wished that Lin Chen would die under the claws of the giant dragon. In this way, Lin Chen's precious Blood Abyss Token and resources would naturally become their prize.
In the distance, Jian Shang and Yuan Tianming were also hiding in the dark, watching. Seeing Lin Chen being ferociously attacked by the giant dragon, both of them looked elated, with gloating glints in their eyes. Obviously, they were looking forward to Lin Chen being killed by the dragon on the spot more than anyone else.
In an instant, the giant dragon exuded a suffocating and astonishing pressure, and the dragon's power was like a substantial wave crushing all around. Naturally, Lin Chen could clearly feel the overwhelming dragon's power. The dragon's power was so vast that even the air became sticky and heavy under its sweep. There is nothing wrong with that dragonYu, with an aura that would destroy the world, attacked Lin Chen, and his every move and every move erupted with frightening and frightening combat power. Not long after, the giant dragon roared over, and its huge shadow completely enveloped Lin Chen.
However, the giant dragon soon realized that the human in front of him did not seem to be so easy to deal with. Its eyes shone with extreme greed, and it only wanted to devour the coveted dragon blood in Lin Chen's body, but it seriously underestimated Lin Chen's true combat power. This giant dragon has the blood of the true demon dragon flowing in its body. It can be said that the power of the blood is absolutely extremely powerful. Ordinary practitioners cannot even stand in front of it. However, when the giant dragon faced Lin Chen, it attacked fiercely for several rounds in a row, but it failed to get any advantage. Instead, it was beaten by Lin Chen's counterattack, making its dragon scales fly and became furious.
The giant dragon looked up to the sky and roared, its roar shaking the heaven and the earth. And amidst the deafening roar of the dragon, a figure quietly approached - Jian Shang actually rushed back. Beside Jian Shang, there was another strong man. This man exuded a frightening pressure, and his aura was even stronger than Jian Shang's. This person is none other than another genius secretly cultivated by the Guangming Sect, named Zuo Lengchan.
Zuo Lengchan's aura was as solid as a mountain, and the fluctuations in his aura made the surrounding air faintly distorted. His overall combat power is even better than Jian Shang. The Guangming Sect will decide the future ownership of the entire Guangming Holy City through a grand gathering of thousands of sects, and even determine the successor of the next city lord of the entire Guangming Holy City, so the geniuses they cultivate can be said to be endless. Jian Shang was just one of them who was secretly cultivated. In comparison, Zuo Lengchan's combat power was even better, and he was one of the trump cards that the Guangming Sect had high hopes for.
Zuo Lengchan saw Lin Chen fighting fiercely with the giant dragon from a distance, murderous intent flashed in his eyes, and he rushed over without any hesitation. Now was the most suitable time to kill Lin Chen. If he missed it, it would be extremely difficult to find such an opportunity again. With that giant dragon in front to contain them, the dragon's combat power is powerful enough and can be a big help to them. If you team up with the giant dragon to attack from a pincer, your chances of winning will be at least several percent higher.
Zuo Lengchan and Jian Shang looked at each other, and both of them performed terrifying killing moves at the same time. The leader of the Guangming Sect had already issued a death order, and Lin Chen must be completely suppressed, so Zuo Lengchan came without hesitation, with a simple and direct purpose. But in Lin Chen's view, the menacing dragon in front of him was not an invincible enemy, but a huge Blood Abyss Token. The Blood Abyss Token obviously also has obvious grades. Compared with the Blood Abyss Token transformed from an ordinary war beast, the quality is simply not the same as that of a giant dragon of this level. Of course, what Lin Chen wants is the best quality Blood Abyss Token, and the giant dragon in front of him will most likely be able to meet his needs.
Lin Chen's eyes flashed with burning golden light, and it could be said that he longed for this giant dragon to the extreme. It just so happened that the giant dragon also wanted Lin Chen's life. One person and one dragon could be said to "hit it off". The giant dragon roared, charging across the sky with incomparable terrifying pressure. Its huge dragon claws tore through the void and struck down with a force that could destroy the world. At the same time, Zuo Lengchan, Jian Shang, and Yuan Tianming, the proud men of the Guangming Sect, also arrived at the same time, and got stuck right at the moment when Lin Chen was engaging in a fierce physical fight with the giant dragon. As soon as they made a move, they launched a series of tricks without any fancy. The killing moves came out one after another and were extremely powerful. It was clear that they wanted to kill Lin Chen in one fell swoop.
Naturally, Lin Chen would not tolerate them. Not being able to use magical weapons will indeed have a certain impact on him, but his swordsmanship strength and the power of dragon blood in his body have been greatly improved compared to before. Even without the use of magic weapons, the loss of combat power is not as great as outsiders imagine. What's more, most of the people who come to the Blood Abyss Secret Realm are young geniuses, and there are not a few strong men from the older generation to hold the line. Even if there are so fewThe genius of the True Self Realm is only at the early stage of the True Self Realm, and cannot be compared with Lin Chen at all.
In an instant, Lin Chen was fighting many powerful enemies alone. Sword light and dragon breath intertwined, murderous intent intertwined with roars, and the scene was extremely chaotic. At this moment, Ye Qingshuang's figure appeared through the sky. Ye Qingshuang had gone elsewhere before, and now she sensed that Lin Chen might be in danger, so he immediately rushed to Lin Chen and blocked Lin Chen's side without hesitation. Of course, Ye Qingshuang would not just watch something happen to Lin Chen. Her aura surged around her body, her eyes were as cold as frost, and she did not show any fear when she glanced at the besiegers.
Zuo Lengchan had actually met Ye Qingshuang before, but at that time he didn't take Ye Qingshuang seriously at all, thinking that her combat power was far inferior to Lin Chen and that she was just a character that was not worth worrying about. At this moment, after a head-on confrontation, Ye Qingshuang was able to withstand his fierce attack, relying on her tyrannical physical strength to fight Zuo Lengchan back and forth, and even vaguely gained the upper hand. This made Zuo Lengchan extremely depressed.
You know, what Zuo Lengchan is best at is the way of the physical body, and his physical strength is unparalleled. Once the Overlord's body breaks out, it can crush people of the same level as if it were devastating, which has always been his biggest trump card. After sensing the power of Zuo Lengchan's overlord body, Ye Qingshuang did not hesitate at all. She raised her hand and punched out with a fierce wind and a rainbow-like momentum. Zuo Lengchan's Overlord Body was certainly powerful, but Ye Qingshuang's Peerless Body was equally terrifying. The two collided together, like two mountains colliding head-on. After a round of blows, Zuo Lengchan, who had the body of an overlord, was instantly knocked out. His body turned several somersaults in the air before he managed to stabilize himself. At this moment, Zuo Lengchan's eyes were full of fear.
Zuo Lengchan never expected that Ye Qingshuang could be so strong. He really couldn't understand it. Ye Qingshuang's every punch carried incomparable power, and the power of the punch was as continuous as thunder in the sky, which made Zuo Lengchan's mentality collapse. You must know that the most powerful thing about the Overlord's body is its unparalleled physical strength. With the Overlord's body, he has always been invincible.
